In the past I'd spend as much or more on the tanning lotions as I did on the membership to the beds themselves.  Darksyde is incredibly cheap and has turned my skin from pale ghost to golden god in a matter of a week.  I can't emphasize enough how important the lotion is in tanning, and this one has great color and effectiveness, and smells neither super-girly nor like playdoh like almost all others, so it's a perfect middle ground.  I'll be buying more very soon.

I have been using this product for about 3 weeks now, and I will say that I can see a dramatic difference in my color. I actually noticed a drastic difference after only one use. It does leave me a slight orangish color if I use too much at once. I suspect that there is some sort of self tanner in it as well,  because after the first use I did not wash it off of my hands and they were stained orange for nearly a week. All-in-all, a good product if used sparingly.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the low price and good value of the lotion.
Many reviewers report getting noticeably darker or faster tanning results.
The lotion's thin consistency is commonly mentioned, with most seeing it as a positive but a few disliking it.
The scent is widely liked, often described as pleasant and beach-like.
A few reviewers felt the color results were minimal or the product was disappointing.
